title: Constructible flat models for Noetherian coefficient rings
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, put $\Lambda=\mathbf F_\ell$, let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme (one admitting a finite affine cover by spectra of Noetherian rings [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]), and let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian $\Lambda$-algebra. Work in the ordinary derived categories of module sheaves on the small etale site $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. For a commutative ring $R$, write $D^b_c(X_{\mathrm{et}},R)$ for complexes with bounded cohomology admitting a finite locally closed stratification [def-constructible-stratification] on each stratum of which (after restriction) each cohomology sheaf is locally constant of finite type [def-weil-pbc-locally-constant-finite-type-modules], i.e. locally constant with finitely generated $R$-module stalks [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]; for $R=\Lambda$ this is [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes]. Write $D^b_{ctf}(X_{\mathrm{et}},R)$ for the full subcategory of these objects $P$ for which there are integers $a\le b$ such that $P\otimes^L_{R_X}F$ has cohomology only in $[a,b]$ for every $R_X$-module sheaf $F$ in degree zero, using the constant coefficient sheaf and derived tensor of [def-kun-derived-tensor]. For every $K\in D^b_{ctf}(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ of Tor amplitude $[a,b]$, there is a representing cochain complex [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] $F^\bullet$ with $F^q=0$ outside $[a,b]$ and each $F^q$ flat and constructible. Flat means that tensoring module sheaves with $F^q$ is exact. Moreover there is a finite locally closed stratification by connected reduced subschemes $S_i$ and connected finite etale Galois covers $V_i\to S_i$ on which all the nonzero terms $F^q|_{S_i}$ become constant with finitely generated projective $A$-module values (direct summands of finite free modules). Galois here means a cover with a finite group acting simply transitively on each geometric fibre. The empty scheme is allowed.

source.place: Tag 03TT, lemma-when-ctf, and the following remark-projective-each-degree; simultaneous Galois trivialization after stratification as in ILO XVII 7.3.1 and the proof of 7.6.1, p. 314.
